asset_name: FLOWFORM LumaSkin XR Research V1 Concept
visible_design_intent: adjustable soft garment rather than a powered exoskeleton
removable IMU, contact, temperature, current, and timing modules
explicit human-research hold before energized participant testing
current_program_boundary: Software simulation, protocol design, and unoccupied bench preparation only. No garment has been fabricated or energized on a person, and no human test is authorized.
required_engineering_next_steps: complete the executable synthetic state-transition and fault sweep
obtain qualified electrical, thermal, battery, and energy-source review
build and instrument an unoccupied actuator and communication bench
build a mannequin fit, pressure, temperature, and quick-release fixture
complete skin-contact material, hygiene, and wearable hazard review
obtain an institutional ethics or IRB determination before recruiting participants
preregister the randomized crossover analysis and stopping rules
obtain independent protocol acceptance and a signed reproduction receipt before public benefit claims
claim_boundary: This is a deterministic SVG concept diagram, not CAD, not a schematic, not a fabricated prototype, not protective equipment, not an exoskeleton, not a medical device, not a safety certification, not human-test authorization, and not test evidence. It does not prove cue accuracy, comfort improvement, reduced motion sickness, task improvement, fatigue reduction, injury prevention, skin safety, electrical safety, thermal safety, manufacturability, commercial readiness, or regulatory compliance.
